drug_information.description: Opium is the coagulated latex obtained from the opium poppy (Papaver somniferum). It is classified as a narcotic drug under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act, 1985. Unauthorized cultivation, production, possession, sale, purchase, transport and distribution are prohibited except as permitted by law.

small_quantity.source: Government of India Notification S.O. 1055(E), 19 October 2001

commercial_quantity.source: Government of India Notification S.O. 1055(E), 19 October 2001

applicable_ndps_sections.title: Prohibition of Certain Operations
applicable_ndps_sections.applicability: Prohibits unauthorized cultivation, production, possession, sale, purchase, transport, storage and distribution.

applicable_ndps_sections.title: Punishment for Contravention in Relation to Opium Poppy and Opium
applicable_ndps_sections.applicability: Applies to offences involving opium and opium poppy.

investigation_guidelines: Secure the scene before evidence collection.
Maintain an unbroken chain of custody.
Collect representative samples for forensic examination.
Record weight, packaging and identifying marks.
Document witness statements and seizure memo.
storage_guidelines: Store in a secure evidence room.

legal: Government of India Notification S.O. 1055(E), 19 October 2001
operational: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (UNODC)
